name: Det Våras För Lilljorna
source:
Inspired by the cult classic "Hanahira" comes a brand new adventure starring the same cast. IN SWEDISH!
The sky is dark for the stars are in this game!
Take on the role of Karin and experience the antics of her wacky friends.
translation:
一部受邪典经典《花平》启发、由同一批角色主演的全新冒险游戏。使用瑞典语！

天空一片漆黑，因为星星都在游戏里！

扮演香琳，体验她古怪朋友们的胡闹日常。
